feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 May 2026 10:19pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 18 May 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure west of Ireland, moving eastwards, with associated fronts and troughs crossing the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Southeast 4 or 5, occasional 6 in the west of the area, imminently increasing 5 or 6 in all waters, and occasionally 7 in places overnight. Soon veering south tomorrow morning, then south-southwest later in the day.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building mostly moderate overnight, then occasionally rough in southern and central parts of the area later tomorrow afternoon and evening.


##Weather##

Rain clearing to scattered showers tomorrow morning, these becoming isolated during the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in heavier rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South-southwest 5 or 6, veering southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Wednesday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the south at first, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
